rows.reference: Nnukwu mmiri ozizo nwere ike ịme ka kanyọns bụrụ osimiri ji iwe yana egbe eluigwe na amụma ga-ebute oke ifufe na aja na efesasị efe.

rows.output: Mgbaba nke mgbawa ga-ebute mmiri ozuzo dị arọ n'akụkụ ụfọdụ n'akụkụ osimiri Southern California.
rows.reference: Nnukwu oghere ahụ na abịarute ga-ebute ụfọdụ nnukwu mmiri ozizo n’ebe akụkụ osimiri Ndịda California.

rows.output: Mkpụrụ mmiri nke karịrịrị ọkara inch nwere ike ime, nke nwere ike ibute obere mmiri na okporo ụzọ na-adịghị mma.
rows.reference: Mgbakọ mmiri ozizo nke gafere ọkara inchi nwere ike ịdị, nke nwere ike ibute obere ọsụsọ ahịhịa yana okporo ụzọ na amị amị.

rows.output: Nke a ga-abụ mmiri mbụ nke oge mmiri ozuzo na mpaghara a.
rows.reference: Nke a ga-abụ mmiri ozizi izizi nke mpaghara ahụ nke oge udu mmiri ha.

rows.output: Mgbụsị akwụkwọ mmiri ozuzo na-ekpo ọkụ ga-amalite ịbịaru Arizona n'oge ụbọchị Sọnde na mmalite ụbọchị Mọnde, tupu mmiri ozuzo ahụ na-ekpuchi nnukwu mpaghara n'oge ụbọchị Mọnde na Tuzdee.
rows.reference: Ụfọdụ nyọsa oke mmiri ozizo fesara efesa ga-ebido irute Arizona na mgbede Sọnde yana n’isi ụtụtụ Mọnde, tupu mmiri ozizo ahụ agbasasịa na mgbede Mọnde na Tusde.

rows.output: Mmiri dị arọ ga-agbasa n'ime Four Corners na Tuzdee ma nwee ike ịdịru ruo Wednesde.
rows.reference: Nnukwu mmiri ozizo ga-agbasa na Akụkụ Anọ na Tusde ma nọgide ruo Wenesde.

rows.output: Ọktoba nwere ike ịhụ mgbanwe okpomọkụ dị egwu n'ofe U.S. ka Arctic na-ekpo ọkụ, mana tropics na-anọgide na-ekpo ọkụ.
rows.reference: Ọktọba nwere ike ịhụ ụfọdụ mgbanwe temprechọ dị ike n’ofe U.S. ka Arctic na ejuwanye oyi, mana ebe okpomọkụ ga-enwe okpomọkụ.

rows.output: N'oge ụfọdụ, nke a na-ebute mgbanwe dị egwu na okpomọkụ n'ime obere anya.
rows.reference: Oge ụfọdụ nke a na ebute nnukwu mgbanwe na temprechọ n’ofe obere oge.

rows.output: Enwere nnukwu ihe atụ nkedịiche okpomọkụ na-akụda n'etiti etiti U.S. na Sọnde.
rows.reference: Enwere nnukwu ịmaatụ nke ndịiche temprechọ dị egwu gafere n’etiti U.S. na Satọde.

rows.output: Enwere ihe dị ka ọdịiche okpomọkụ 20 degrees n'etiti Kansas City, Missouri, na Omaha, Nebraska, na n'etiti St. Louis na Des Moines, Iowa.
rows.reference: Enwere ihe rutere ndịiche temprechọ digrii-20 n’etiti Kansas City, Missouri, na Omaha, Nebraska, yana n’etiti St. Louis na Des Moined, Iowa.

rows.output: N'ime ụbọchị ole na ole na-abịa, okpomọkụ nke okpomọkụ ga-agbalị iwulite ma gbasaa ọzọ.
rows.reference: N’ụbọchị ole ma ole na abịa, ekpomọkụ ọkọchị ga-anọgide ga-anwa ịkpụkọ ma dọtịa ọzọ.

rows.output: Ọtụtụ n'ime etiti na ọwụwa anyanwụ U.S. na-atụ anya na ha ga-enwe mmalite okpomọkụ nke Ọktoba na 80s nke ukwuu site na Southern Plains ruo akụkụ nke Northeast.
rows.reference: Atụrụ anya na imirikiti n’ebe etiti na ọwụwa anyanwụ U.S. ga-ahụ mbido Ọktọba nwere ekpomọkụ gbasara 80s bido na Ala Ndịda ruo n’akụkụ nke Ọwụwa anyanwụ na ugwu.

rows.output: Obodo New York nwere ike iru 80 degrees na Tuzdee, nke ga-abụ ihe dị ka 10 degrees n'elu nkezi.
rows.reference: New York City nwere ike iru digrii 80 na Tusde, nke ga-abụ ihe dị ka digrii 10 karịa nkezi.

rows.output: Ntụle ihu igwe ogologo oge anyị na-egosi oke ohere maka okpomọkụ dị elu maka ọwụwa anyanwụ U.S. site na ọkara mbụ nke Ọktoba.
rows.reference: Amụma ihuigwe ogologo oge anyị na egosi nnukwu ohere maka nkezi temprechọ ndị dị n’elu maka akụkụ ọwụwa anyanwụ nke U.S. gafere ọkara izizi nke Ọktoba.

rows.output: Karịa nde iri abụọ na nde mmadụ na-ekiri ikpe Brett Kavanaugh
rows.reference: Ihe karịrị ọnụọgụ ndị mmadụ nde 20 lelere ọnụnụ Brett Kavanaugh

rows.output: Karịa nde iri abụọ na otu ndị mmadụ lere anya n'oge na-adịghị anya ikpe Brett Kavanaugh, onye a họpụtara maka Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu, na Christine Blasey Ford, bụ́ nwanyị na-akatọ ya maka mwakpo mmekọahụ nke o boro ebubo mere n'afọ iri asatọ.
rows.reference: Ihe karịrị ọnụọgụ ndị mmadụ nde 20 lelere nkwupụta akaebe nke Tọsde sitere n’aka Brett Kavanaugh onye ahọpụtara maka Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị yana nwanyị boro ya ebubo nke mwakpo n’ike mere na 1980, Christine Blasey Ford, na netwọk igwe onyonyoo isi.

rows.output: N'otu oge ahụ, ọgbụgba ndị ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na-aga n'ihu, ebe ndị na-ekesa ozi na-akụzi ihe nkiri mgbe niile maka mgbanwe ikpeazụ nke Fraịde: nkwekọrịta nke onye ozi Arizona bụ Jeff Flake mere ka ndị FBI mee nyocha nke otu izu n'ihe a na-ekwu.
rows.reference: Ugbu a, nkwụsịdo ike ndọrọndọrọ ahụ gara n’ihu, ndị mgbasa ozi nọ na akwụsịbido mmemme ndị kwesịrị ịme maka ntụgharị nkeji ikpeazụ nke Fraịde ahụ: nkwekọrịta nke Onye Ọmeiwu Jeff Flake nke Arizona zubere maka FBI iji mee nnyocha otu-izu maka ebubo ndị ahụ.

rows.output: Ford gwara Kọmitii Iwu Senate na ọ na-enwe 100 pasentị nke obi ike na Kavanaugh metụrụ ya n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi ma na-agbalị iwepụ uwe ya n'oge oriri na ọṅụṅụ ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndrị.
rows.reference: Ford gwara Ọgbakọ Ndị Ikpe Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu na o doro ya anya pasentị 100 na Kavanaugh ji anya mmanya pịa ya aka ma nwaa iyipu ya akwa n’emume ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndịrị.

rows.output: Kavanaugh, n'okwu na-ekwesịghị ekwesị, kwuru na o nwere pasent 100 nkeị na ọ bụghị ihe mere.
rows.reference: Kavanaugh, na nkwupụta nwere oke mmetụta, kwuru na o doro ya anya pasentị 100 na ọ meghị.

rows.output: Ọ ga-abụ na ihe karịrị nde iri abụọ na anọ ndị Nielsen kwuru na Fraịde hụrụ ya.
rows.reference: Enwere ohere na ihe karịrị ọnụọgụ nde ndị mmadụ 20.4 nke Nielsen kwuru na Friday lelere ya.

rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ na-atụle ndị na-ekiri n'etiti CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel na MSNBC.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ na-agụ nkezi nlele na CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel na MSNBC.

rows.output: Ọ dịghị ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị a na-enye ozugbo maka netwọk ndị ọzọ gbara ya, gụnyere PBS, C-SPAN na Fox Business Network.
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụgụ adịghị ozugbo maka netwọk ndị ọzọ gosiri ya, gụnyere PBS, C-SPAN na Fox Business Network.

rows.output: Ọ na-enwekarị nsogbu ịtụle ndị na-ekiri ihe n'ụlọ ọrụ.
rows.reference: Ma Nielsen na enwekarị nsogbu ịha ndị mmadụ lelere n’ụlọ ọrụ ha.

rows.output: Iji mee ka ọ dị mfe, nke ahụ bụ nnukwu ndị na-ege ntị dị ka egwuregwu bọọlụ nke egwuregwu ikpeazụ ma ọ bụ ihe nrite Academy.
rows.reference: Iji mee ka ịghọta nke ahụ, nke ahụ bụ nha ndị nlele yitere ndị nọ n’ama egwuregwu futbọọlụ onye mmeri ma ọ bụ Academy Awards.

rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ Fox News Channel, nke ndị na-eme ihe nkiri ya na-akwado nkwupụta Kavanaugh, duuru netwọk niile na ndị na-ekiri 5.69 nde n'oge niile nke ikpe ahụ, Nielsen kwuru.
rows.reference: Fox News Channel, ndị nchịkọta ya nwere uche nke ya kwadosiri nhọpụta Kavanaugh ike, gafere netwọk niile site na ịnwe nkezi nke ọnụọgụ ndị nlele nde 5.69 n’oge ọnụnụ ụbọchị-niile ahụ, Nielsen kwuru.
